clue.text: Clean with brush

definitions.meaning: to clean something by rubbing hard is to scour it
brush here is low stunted vegetation or brushwood, the noun sense

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for vigorous cleaning and a noun for stunted bushes or brushwood.

clue.text: Transport level with train

parts.note: a stage is a level or phase reached
to train someone is to coach them

explanation.surface: A vehicle running level with a railway train.
explanation.walkthrough: 'train' looks like a railway noun but is the verb meaning to tutor.
explanation.definitionFit: A horse-drawn passenger vehicle on a scheduled route was a form of public transport.

clue.text: Every executive takes grass

indicators.note: the phrase every executive takes in, or holds, a run of letters straddling its two words

explanation.surface: Each company boss helps themselves to some lawn.
explanation.definitionFit: A cereal grass grown for grain and whisky-making, so an example of a grass.

clue.text: Tippler's heading into therapy the wrong way — one getting into the drink

indicators.note: into signals one piece placed inside another
going the wrong way means the word for therapy is read backwards

parts.note: rehab is short for rehabilitation therapy for addicts

indicators.note: the heading of a word is its first letter, here of Tippler's

explanation.surface: A drinker's head goes into rehab backwards, and someone falls in the drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the wrong way' turns REHAB into BAHER; 'into' puts T (the heading of Tippler's) inside it. 'The drink' is slang for the sea or water.
explanation.definitionFit: A swimmer is someone who goes into the water, which slang calls the drink.

clue.text: Supporter keeps patriarch's daughter screened

indicators.note: keeps means holds inside, so one piece sits within the supporter

parts.note: a tee supports a golf ball before it is struck
Levi was one of the patriarchs, a son of Jacob, so the possessive gives Levi's

explanation.surface: A backer protects a family elder's daughter from view.
explanation.walkthrough: 'screened' looks like hidden from view, but here it means shown on screen. Levi was one of the biblical patriarchs, the sons of Jacob.
explanation.definitionFit: A programme that has been broadcast on TV has been screened.

clue.text: Fund holder ensures variable rate more stable

indicators.note: variable means changeable, so the letters of rate are rearranged

parts.note: surer means steadier or more secure

explanation.surface: A finance officer promises that a fluctuating interest rate is steadier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'variable' gives TREA from RATE; 'ensures' is only a link word here.
explanation.definitionFit: The officer who looks after a club's or society's money holds its funds.

clue.text: Pass away from massive climbing rope

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means the remaining letters are read upwards, backwards
away from means the pass is removed from the word for massive

parts.note: colossal means massive
a col is a mountain pass

explanation.surface: A climber takes a rope over a pass on a huge mountain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'away from' takes COL out of COLOSSAL, leaving OSSAL; 'climbing' turns that upwards in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A rope with a running noose used by cowboys to catch cattle.

clue.text: Sentence from novel is clever

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters of is clever are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A line taken from a book is praised as smart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like a book but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A short sentence said or sung in church liturgy, answered by the congregation.

clue.text: Character passed round hospital, understaffed

indicators.note: round means the word for character goes around another piece

parts.note: a sort is a type of person, as in a good sort
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs
to hand something on is to pass it

explanation.surface: A person sent round a hospital that is short of staff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' sets the word for character around the hospital letter; 'Character' tempts as a letter or symbol, a fair nod to the answer's other meaning.
explanation.definitionFit: Short-handed means lacking enough workers, which is being understaffed.

clue.text: Very late

definitions.meaning: the late someone is a person who has died

explanation.definitionFit: The word works as an intensifying adverb (dead easy) and as a description of the deceased.

clue.text: Showing attentive nature, waiter finally returned to fill drinks

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held: 'Showing attentive nature, waiter finally returned to fill drinks' (9). ALES (drinks) around R (waiter finally) leaves TNES unexplained; nothing in the clue as printed gives SENT backwards, so it looks misread or garbled.
annotationWithheld.clue: Showing attentive nature, waiter finally returned to fill drinks

clue.text: Drink port, then drink short

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port, often just Rio

indicators.note: short means the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: a jar is British slang for a drink, as in a jar at the pub

explanation.surface: Have a drink in a seaport, then a small one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' cuts JAR to JA. A jar is British slang for a glass of beer.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish red wine from the region of that name, so a drink.

clue.text: Munch, for example, quick Chinese put back into it

parts.note: an express train or delivery is a quick one

indicators.note: into means placed inside the word it
put back means the word for Chinese is reversed

parts.note: Sino- is the combining form meaning Chinese

explanation.surface: Someone eats quickly, Chinese food being put back into it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put back' reverses the Chinese prefix; 'into' sets it inside the clue's it. Edvard Munch, painter of The Scream, belongs to that movement.
explanation.definitionFit: Edvard Munch is an example of an artist of the movement that painted emotion rather than reality.

clue.text: Pronouncement, a parting prophesy

indicators.note: parting means splitting the word open so the a goes inside

parts.note: prophesy, the noun form spelt prophecy, is a prediction

explanation.surface: A farewell statement that foretells the future.
explanation.walkthrough: 'parting' looks like a farewell but means A splits PREDICTION open.
explanation.definitionFit: Predication is the act of stating or declaring, so a pronouncement.

clue.text: Certainly using every possible method

definitions.meaning: certainly, as a polite agreement: of course
employing all ways that are available

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a polite way of saying of course, and literally means through all available routes.

clue.text: Unit of test completed

definitions.meaning: in a cricket Test match, a unit of six balls bowled by one bowler

explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a set of six deliveries is one, and the word also means finished.

clue.text: Where those in order are about to cultivate plant

indicators.note: about means the friary goes around the word for cultivate

parts.note: friars belong to a religious order and live in a friary
to till the soil is to cultivate it

explanation.surface: Monks in a religious house are about to grow a plant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'on the point of' but is the wrapping signal; 'to' is only a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A bulbous plant of the lily family with chequered drooping flowers, such as snake's head.

clue.text: Trumpeted communication?

parts.note: an elephant trumpets through its long nose, so a message from that organ is an old term for a long-distance telephone connection

explanation.definitionFit: An old British term for a long-distance telephone call made through an operator.

clue.text: Having set up funds without a shilling, I close a large estate

indicators.note: without means the shilling is removed
in a down clue set up means read upwards, reversed

parts.note: cash means money or funds
S was the abbreviation for a shilling, from Latin solidus
a close is an end or conclusion

explanation.surface: Having raised money without spending a shilling, I conclude buying a big estate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' turns CASH into HSAC; 'without' takes out S (old British shilling), leaving HAC.
explanation.definitionFit: A hacienda is a large landed estate or ranch in Spanish-speaking countries.

clue.text: Like a knight with cape, his valour extraordinary

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cape on maps

indicators.note: extraordinary means out of the ordinary, so the letters of his valour are rearranged

explanation.surface: A caped knight shows his remarkable courage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extraordinary' signals the anagram, with C placed first; 'with' is only a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Chivalry was the code of medieval knights, so being gallant and courteous is knightly.

clue.text: Pin-up by pool heading for the far end

indicators.note: the heading, or first letter, of the word for pool travels to the far end

parts.note: a lido is a public open-air swimming pool

explanation.surface: A glamour model beside a swimming pool walks off to the deep end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading for the far end' takes L, the first letter of LIDO, to the back. A lido is a British open-air pool.
explanation.definitionFit: A pin-up is someone admired whose picture is on a wall, so an object of adoration.

clue.text: Perhaps nit is brainwashed?

definitions.meaning: a nit, the egg of a louse, is an example of a small creature with six legs
read as ..., someone indoctrinated by a cult

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense splits as IN SECT: a brainwashed person is in a sect. 'is' is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: A louse or its egg is an example of a six-legged creature, and in sect describes cult members.

clue.text: Family in Milan go mad for corruption, the beastly lot

indicators.note: in means the word for family sits inside the rearranged letters
corruption means being mangled, so the letters of milan go mad are rearranged

parts.note: kin means family or relatives

explanation.surface: A Milan clan goes crazy over corruption, a beastly bunch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for corruption' rearranges the Milan words to ANIMALGDOM; 'in' then sets the family word inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The biological kingdom containing all animals is literally every beast together.

clue.text: Promise to see something shiny having lifted wig

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold, a shiny metal

indicators.note: in a down clue lifted means the word for wig is read upwards, reversed

parts.note: rug is slang for a wig or toupee

explanation.surface: A promise to see something glittering once the toupee is raised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lifted' turns RUG into GUR. A rug is slang for a toupee.
explanation.definitionFit: To augur is to promise or foreshadow, as in that augurs well.

clue.text: King breaks the mould as goody-goody

indicators.note: breaks means goes into, splitting the word for mould

parts.note: a pig is a mould or oblong mass of cast metal, as in pig iron
R is the abbreviation for king, from Latin rex

explanation.surface: A monarch breaks the mould by being a prude.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaks the mould' looks like an idiom for innovating; it puts R inside PIG, a casting mould.
explanation.definitionFit: A prig is a self-righteous person, which is a goody-goody.

clue.text: Rule which is good kept in check

indicators.note: kept in means the abbreviation for good is held inside the word for check

parts.note: to rein in is to check or restrain

explanation.surface: A good rule is one held under control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kept in' puts G inside REIN; 'which is' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A reign is a monarch's period of rule, so the noun rule.

clue.text: A defective boat back touring a country

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the reversed run surrounds the second a
back means the run of a, defective and boat is read in reverse

parts.note: lame means weak or defective, as in a lame excuse
a tug is a small boat that tows ships

explanation.surface: A broken-down boat returns after touring a country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns A + LAME + TUG into GUTEMALA; 'touring' wraps that around the second A.
explanation.definitionFit: A Central American republic lying south of Mexico.

clue.text: James Bond almost overcome by a killer

indicators.note: in a down clue overcome by means placed underneath, so the a comes first
almost means the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: James Bond is a fictional spy

explanation.surface: James Bond is nearly beaten by an assassin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' reduces SPY to SP; 'overcome by' in a down clue puts A above it.
explanation.definitionFit: A venomous snake, famous for killing Cleopatra, so a killer.

clue.text: Tommy Cooper's creation is a bore, to be absolutely straight

parts.note: a Tommy gun is a Thompson submachine gun
a cooper is a maker of casks, so his product is a barrel

explanation.surface: A comedian's stage act is tedious, frankly speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: Tommy Cooper was a British comedian and magician; the name splits into a Tommy gun and a cooper (cask maker). 'Gun-barrel straight' means perfectly straight, the closing flourish.
explanation.definitionFit: The bore of a firearm is its tube, which is what this phrase names.

clue.text: Use as food in bar

parts.note: to tap a resource is to use or draw on it

explanation.surface: Something to be used as food in a bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Use' looks like a noun but is the verb tap, to draw on.
explanation.definitionFit: Small Spanish savoury dishes served with drinks in a bar.
